title: Second distinct smallest (with a sentinel)
prompt:
Return the **second distinct smallest** value; return -1 when it does not exist (empty, one element, or all values equal).

Examples: `{4,1,4,2}` → `2`; `{5,5}` → `-1`; `{-1,-1,3}` → `3`.

tests.name: second smallest
tests.hint: Two passes: find min, then min among values strictly greater than it; -1 if none.
